name: useful-claude-add-ons
description: Internal marketplace of Claude Code skills and plugins for the team - APIs, security tooling, workflow automation, and productivity add-ons.

plugins.name: aws-opensearch
plugins.description: Diagnose and remediate Amazon OpenSearch Service managed domains over SigV4, with dry-run guards on destructive calls.

plugins.name: bitbucket
plugins.description: Git over HTTPS with Atlassian API tokens plus the Bitbucket Cloud REST API - PRs, pipelines, comments, branches.

plugins.name: checkpoint-email
plugins.description: Check Point Email Security (Harmony Email & Collaboration / Avanan) - search, triage, and remediate with dry-run gates.

plugins.name: cisco-meraki
plugins.description: Cisco Meraki Dashboard API v1 - inventory, status, event and config-change logs, live diagnostics, and MX/MS/MR config changes with snapshot/diff/confirm and rollback.

plugins.name: claude-code-defaults
plugins.description: Configure how Claude Code behaves by default - CLAUDE.md instructions, settings.json, permission allow/deny/ask rules and modes, hooks, default model, and which scope (user/project/local/managed) each belongs in.

plugins.name: claude-code-tuneup
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code install for what makes it slow or bloated - duplicate skills, per-tool-call hooks, SessionStart injections, disabled-but-installed plugins, overlapping MCP servers, oversized CLAUDE.md - and return a ranked cleanup plan.

plugins.name: claude-memories-canvas
plugins.description: Canvas conventions for the claude-memories vault - wiki/maps schema, colours, ids, column-and-group geometry, and the rules that keep a canvas findable.

plugins.name: claude-memories-vault
plugins.description: Note conventions for the claude-memories Obsidian vault - folder layout, the six frontmatter fields, wikilink resolution, the write lock, and vault vs auto-memory.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare v4 API - DNS, zones, cache, WAF, page rules, SSL/TLS, Workers/KV/R2, Zero Trust, analytics.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Virtual dev team for multi-repo legacy work - 9 context-isolated agents, 14 slash commands, 14 bundled skills, and deterministic hooks that block unsafe commands, gate unverified turns, and carry a handoff across compaction.

plugins.name: drata
plugins.description: Drata Public API - controls, monitoring tests, evidence, personnel, policies, frameworks, risks across US/EU/APAC.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly output shaping - leads with next action, numbers steps, suppresses tangents. Manual invoke via /i-have-adhd.

plugins.name: infra-work-ticketing
plugins.description: Infrastructure work ticketing for Zoho ServiceDesk Plus Cloud and Jira Cloud - confirm a ticket exists, log work notes as the work happens, or open a ticket.

plugins.name: intune-graph
plugins.description: Microsoft Intune via Microsoft Graph - device troubleshooting, compliance/config profiles, app deployment, report exports.

plugins.name: mermaid-svg-bitbucket
plugins.description: Pre-render Mermaid diagrams to committed SVG so they display correctly in Bitbucket Cloud.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Notify a session's progress to your phone or inbox - a two-way Telegram bot (questions wait for your reply, topic-per-job dispatcher) or email over SMTP/an MCP connector.

plugins.name: obsidian-canvas
plugins.description: Create and edit Obsidian Canvas (.canvas) files directly as JSON Canvas - architecture maps, decision trees, and boards with embedded live notes, groups, and labeled arrows; no plugin or REST bridge required.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-server
plugins.description: Self-hosted Obsidian vault on Ubuntu - containerised desktop app, obsidian.md Sync, and the Local REST API MCP endpoint over an SSH tunnel.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Generate and refresh a full documentation set for a codebase - CLAUDE.md, READMEs, API reference, architecture doc, TODO/SECURITY/CHANGELOG, and handoff notes.

plugins.name: shipstation
plugins.description: ShipStation across V2, legacy V1, and ShipEngine - shipments, labels, rates, carriers, warehouses, inventory, products, orders, tracking, batches, manifests.

plugins.name: sophos-central
plugins.description: Sophos Central API - endpoint management, alert triage, SIEM export, XDR/Live Discover, firewall management.

plugins.name: terraform-docs-readme
plugins.description: Regenerate a Terraform module's README.md with terraform-docs - .terraform-docs.yml, main.tf header block, footer.md, and the BEGIN_TF_DOCS/END_TF_DOCS injection markers.

plugins.name: visio-diagrams
plugins.description: Create, edit, and verify Microsoft Visio .vsdx diagrams - stdlib-only generator from a YAML/JSON spec with no Visio install needed, plus COM automation for real stencil masters.

plugins.name: wazuh-onprem
plugins.description: Self-hosted Wazuh across Server API, Indexer API, Dashboard saved-objects API, and ossec.conf over SSH.

plugins.name: web-testing-playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser with Playwright - screenshots across viewports, console errors, failed requests, form and login flows, plus Windows/Linux browser setup.

plugins.name: work-log-reporter
plugins.description: Per-session work log in a committed work-log/ directory, plus a formatted email report with a PDF attachment sent over SMTP.
